title: Technical Document and Specification Generator — Overview and definition
t: Technical Document and Specification Generator — Overview and definition
description: Drafts datasheets, manuals, and specifications from structured engineering data.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Drafts datasheets, manuals, and specifications from structured engineering data. A technical document generator fills document templates from parts data, test results, and CAD metadata, producing datasheets, user manuals, and compliance documents with consistent terminology. Real implementations use Sphinx/AsciiDoc pipelines, DITA toolchains, and MadCap Flare. It enforces style guides, manages warnings/cautions, and versions every generated document.
capabilities: Template-driven generation from structured data sources
Terminology enforcement and style-guide checking
Warning/caution/note management per safety standards
Multi-format output: PDF, HTML, ePub from one source
Versioning and change highlighting between revisions

body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Technical Document and Specification Generator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Template-driven generation from structured data sources). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Template-driven generation from structured data sources and Terminology enforcement and style-guide checking. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Engineering report and graph generator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
